programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: The Trouble With Spies
programme.desc: George Trent, a British spy, has gone incommunicado in Ibiza. Appleton Porter (Donald Sutherland) is sent to find out what happened to Trent. Porter settles into a small hotel with several busybody guests. He probes them for information about Trent, their former neighbor. Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Mission for the Dragon
programme.desc: Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

programme.title: Carnival Of Souls
programme.desc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade puts in some early summer farm work to Ensure his target bucks are well fed! Slade also Talks about his Target buck for the year, "Pope"! Slade is laying the trap early in hopes "Pope" makes a mistake early!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don’t miss it.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. programme.desc: In Episode 3, Josh starts off in the Twin Cities where he meets up with Yia Vang, an award-winning Hmong chef and restaurant owner, bringing his family’s traditions and flavors to the American Midwest. As Josh heads up north to Duluth and the boundary waters, he’ll meet plenty of farmers and foragers—harvesting mushrooms, wild rice, and catching a few fish (and waves) along the way. It all wraps up with an epic feast hosted by Yia back in the cities.

programme.desc: In the sparsely populated country of Namibia, in southern Africa, Dan Cabela visits conservationist Robin Hurt to see how private land ownership and hunting have restored the landscape to a thriving wildlife area.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff venture deep into Maine’s backcountry with their buddy Chuck, ice fishing remote lakes only reachable by snowmobile. Their journey ends at the legendary “ghost trains,” a pair of abandoned locomotives that now rest as silent monuments to a forgotten logging era.

programme.desc: We highlight organizations and programs making a difference in the Florida Keys. Learn how they help protect and restore these vital ecosystems.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: In Episode 10 Boat Trader heads to central Texas to explore boating culture in the lone star state. Second only to Alaska in size, Texas is known as the place where everything is bigger. From big college football games to endless oil fields and vast wind farms, Texas is home to more than 30 million Americans. But the state is about more than just big oil, college football and cattle farms - it's also home to some of the best boating in the country. Boasting a myriad of waterways, boaters here enjoy hundreds of lakes, rivers and streams that provide recreational opportunities, abundant wildlife and plenty of fishing. From Austin Texas to San Antonio host Ryan McVinney and the Boat Trader crew explore the laid-back Texas lake life including boat up restaurants along the Colorado River, watersports in Austin and the history of the waterways throughout the region. Boat manufacturers highlighted in this episode are Tige Boats and ATX Surf Boats, two premium Texas-based wake boat brands known for their high-quality, cutting-edge vessels that come equipped with advanced wake shaping technologies and equipment ideal for water skiing, wake surfing and wakeboarding. There's even a wake surfing dog!

programme.desc: Michael and Larken travel to South Carolina's Lowcountry for a massive barbecue charity event supporting children battling serious illness. After serving up smoke for a great cause, they spend an extra day in the marsh chasing redfish and speckled trout.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett’s body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn’t just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct? - In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask: - When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors

programme.title: The Journey Within

programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: A California collector gambles on a big payday from his Crocker/Caddy combo.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: “The Century Race”: Dale believes he found the bike that will help him beat a rival in an annual race of 100 year old motorcycles. But will it run?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: “A Motorcycle Crime Story”: The horrific tale of a double murder over money and motorcycles.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: “Yes, Dale there is a 100 Year Old Harley”: Dale hopes his labor of love becomes a prized possession when a six-figure Harley goes to auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: A thousand bulging barns of choppers, bobbers, and board trackers are emptied and on display in the Quad Cities.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: A vague tip leads Matt and Dale into a WWII era military warehouse and beyond.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: A cross-country race to lay claim to some of the world’s most sought after works specials.

programme.title: What's in the Barn

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: Shark Tank Mexico
programme.desc: En el episodio 12 de Shark Tank México: un emprendedor con un producto que dejará secos los bolsillos de los tiburones (Dry me) un amante de la naturaleza que convirtió su pasión por los hongos en un negocio muy interesante (Garden Kuuts) un pequeño inventor con una idea que podría salvar a miles de personas con insomnio en todo México (Banda Neutónica) y una pareja de socios que le dio un segundo aire a una técnica artesanal mexicana (Arte Mex).

programme.title: Shark Tank Mexico
programme.desc: En el episodio 413 de Shark Tank México: Una empresa familiar que concentra más de 20 años de investigación y desarrollo, con un gran sentido para los negocios (Sal Verde) una emprendedora inmobiliaria que trae un cómodo negocio para los tiburones (L&L) y un amante del fútbol con un producto que provocará gran entusiasmo a los fanáticos de este deporte (Triport).

programme.title: Shark Tank Mexico
programme.desc: En el sexto episodio de Shark Tank México: un matrimonio que desarrolló un producto para los amantes del café, sin cafeína… y sin café (Kaffee de higo) un emprendedor con un dispositivo que podría ahorrar miles de litros de agua en todo México (Breeze Water) una familia con un producto que quiere ser el ajonjolí de todos los tiburones (Mole Ayuhui) y dos socios con una plataforma digital que podría llevarse de viaje a los tiburones (Jubel).

programme.title: Shark Tank Mexico

programme.title: Shark Tank Mexico

programme.title: Shark Tank Mexico

programme.title: Amigos hasta el final
programme.desc: Aunque Joey le ha diezmado sus puntos de vida, Yugi no se atreve a atacar a su querido amigo. Yugi convoca al monstruo favorito de Joey, el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, para intentar que Joey recupere la cordura.

programme.title: Amigos hasta el final
programme.desc: Yugi empieza a romper el hechizo de Marik sobre Joey, pero ahora debe batirse en duelo sin el Rompecabezas del Milenio. Cuando Joey roba la carta que necesita para diezmar los puntos de vida de Yugi, ¿qué posibilidades le quedan para ganar?

programme.title: Amigos hasta el final
programme.desc: Solo queda un minuto de duelo para que el perdedor caiga en las profundidades del mar. ¿Se enviarán estos mejores amigos a su perdición? Sin embargo, puede haber una salvadora especial que acaba de recuperar la vista.

programme.title: ¡Que empiecen los finalistas!
programme.desc: ¡Que comience la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla! Los ocho finalistas pondrán a prueba su habilidad y resistencia en una arena de duelo a miles de metros de altura.

programme.desc: Es el primer duelo de la final. Yugi se enfrenta al espíritu maligno del Anillo del Milenio que posee a Bakura. Yugi se deshace de los grotescos espectros de Bakura, pero él tiene una estrategia sacada directamente del cementerio…

programme.title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura
programme.desc: Bakura activa el Tablero del Destino, que hará que Yugi pierda automáticamente en cinco turnos. Por si fuera poco, el Santuario Oscuro de Bakura daña los puntos de vida de Yugi cada vez que ataca! Sin poder atacar y sin tiempo, Yugi está atrapado.

programme.title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura
programme.desc: Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Yugi está a punto de dar el golpe final para ganar el duelo, pero Bakura podría no sobrevivir a la explosión del todopoderoso monstruo egipcio.

programme.title: La furia de los dioses egipcios
programme.desc: ¡Por fin se revela el origen de las cartas de dioses egipcios! El misterioso Shadi lleva a Yugi a un viaje a través del tiempo hasta la creación de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡y los peligrosos poderes que liberó!

programme.title: El despertar del mal
programme.desc: En el segundo duelo de la final, Odion, disfrazado de Marik, desconcierta a Joey con numerosas trampas para llevar el duelo a un punto muerto. Sin embargo, Joey cuenta con la Tornado Gigante, la contrapartida perfecta que garantiza la victoria de Joey.

programme.title: El despertar del mal
programme.desc: Las Encarnaciones de Apophis de Odion se ensañan con los monstruos de Joey... ¡y con sus puntos de vida! ¿Podrá Joey utilizar eficazmente los monstruos que ganó antes en el torneo, o está ya demasiado nervioso para montar un contraataque exitoso?

programme.title: El despertar del mal
programme.desc: Es un frenesí devorador porque el Serket de Odion devora a los monstruos de Joey para transformarse en poderosas etapas de evolución. ¿Cómo puede Joey derrotar a Serket cuando éste ingiere los monstruos de Joey cada vez que los invoca en el campo?

programme.title: ¡La venganza del cangrejo!
programme.desc: Gingka se niega a luchar contra un villano obsesionado con los cangrejos llamado Tetsuya Watarigani, pero cuando Watarigani revela que se ha llevado a Madoka y no la liberará hasta que Gingka acepte luchar, Gingka no tiene otra opción. Se produce una batalla acalorada, con mucho juego encubierto por parte de Watarigani. Justo cuando Gingka está contra la pared, Madoka regresa. Ella fue salvada por nada menos que ... Benkei.

programme.title: El reto de Acuario
programme.desc: Los Cazadores de caras se encuentran con Hikaru Hasama, quien hizo un voto a su madre hace años de que se convertiría en la mejor beyblader del mundo. Ella sabe que debe vencer a Gingka, así que lo desafía a través de Benkei. Gingka se ha resfriado y Madoka insiste en que descanse un poco antes de volver a luchar.

programme.title: ¡Es nuestra jugada estrella, Sagitario!
programme.desc: Benkei es mentor de Kenta para que el joven espadachín pueda enfrentar a Hikaru nuevamente y derrotarla. Madoka le da a Kenta una cara de metal para agregar a su bey de Sagitario y le dice que podría ayudarlo a crear un movimiento especial. Mientras tanto, Hikaru descubre que no derrotó a Gingka, fue Kenta haciéndose pasar por Gingka.

programme.title: La peligrosa trampa de Merci
programme.desc: Para demostrar su disposición a luchar contra Gingka, Doji envía a Kyoya al Cañón del Lobo, donde debe escalar una montaña traicionera, combatiendo los elementos, incluidos los lobos salvajes. Mientras tanto, los jóvenes amigos de Kenta le ruegan a Benkei que los entrene también y él cede.

programme.title: El contraataque de Leone
programme.desc: Cuando Kyoya regresa de Wolf Canyon, disuelve a los Cazadores de caras y desafía a Benkei a una batalla que resulta ser destructiva. Kenta llega para ayudar a Benkei, pero fue en vano: los ataques de Kyoya son tan intensos que el almacén en sí está destruido. Mientras tanto, Gingka alcanza a Hikaru, la felicita por su batalla con Kenta y la reta a una batalla.

programme.title: Un combate encarnizado: Gingka contra Kyoya
programme.desc: Kenta lleva de vuelta a la Benkei B-Pit y parece que está en su último aliento ... le pide Gingka para enseñar Kyoya el verdadero significado de beyblading. Gingka promete hacerlo justo cuando Benkei comienza a roncar. Gingka encuentra con Kyoya y la lucha está en Kyoya con la creación de un tornado que rasga a través de la ciudad. La multitud se reúne y anima a Gingka.

programme.title: ¡A la caza del lobo!
programme.desc: búsquedas gingka para Doji y la sede de la nebulosa oscura determinaron para encontrar Prohibida Bey de Doji, L-Drago, que es el mal. La pandilla ayuda a Gingka a buscar, pero no es hasta que Kyoya aparece con una pista de que pueden encontrar la Nebulosa Oscura. Fuera de la fortaleza, Doji envía una variedad de ataques beyblade su camino.

programme.title: Adentrándose en el castillo de los nebulosas oscuras
programme.desc: Gingka, Kyoya, Kenta, Madoka y Benkei paseo por el castillo Dark Nebula donde la voz de Doji reta para que sea a la planta superior. Ellos tratan de subir, pero Merci ha puesto en marcha una serie de obstáculos para ellos, incluyendo el mal patinadores individuales. Kyoya insiste en que puede manejarlos mientras Gingka continúa solo. Kyoya utiliza Lion 100 Fang Fury y derriba a los gemelos.

programme.title: L-dragón despierta
programme.desc: En el interior del castillo de Dark Nebula, Gingka encuentra cara a cara con un némesis perdido hace mucho tiempo ... Ryuga que lleva el Bey Prohibida, L-Drago. Gingka revela que Ryuga es la única persona que nunca perdonará. A sobreviene de batalla en el que la ira de los combustibles gingka L-Drago poder. Ryuga le incita a ir contando Gingka que su padre no era fuerte tampoco.

programme.title: Recuerdos de Ryo
programme.desc: Kenta se enfrenta a Gingka y Gingka habla sobre su pasado. Nos enteramos de que el padre de Gingka, Ryo, era el dueño original del Bey Pegasus y un archirival de Ryuga. Ryuga derrotó a Ryo en una batalla entre Pegasus y el Prohibido Bey Lightning L-Drago. Las últimas palabras de Ryo a su hijo son derrotar a Ryuga para que pueda devolver a L-Drago al lugar que le corresponde.

programme.title: El misterioso Hyoma
programme.desc: Cuando Kenta encuentra una carta de Gingka que dice adiós, la pandilla se dispuso a encontrarlo en su pueblo natal de Koma Village. Frente a los desafíos de cruzar una montaña traicionera en el camino hacia la aldea, Kyoya y Benkei toman una ruta mientras que Madoka y Kenta toman otra. Ambas partes se encuentran independientemente con un misterioso viajero llamado Hyoma que los ayuda, pero al mismo tiempo parece no decir la verdad.

programme.title: El magnífico Aries
programme.desc: Benkei, Kyoya, Kenta y Madoka siguen a su nueva guía, Hyoma, por los traicioneros senderos de montaña mientras intentan encontrar la aldea de Koma y reunirse con Gingka. Kyoya sospecha que Hyoma los está guiando en círculos y lo demuestra. También expone a Hyoma como Blader y lo reta a una batalla. Tanto Kenta como Benkei luchan contra Hyoma y su bey Aries y son derrotados.

programme.title: El Pegasus plateado
programme.desc: La pandilla finalmente llega a Koma Village, pero Gingka no está allí. Se encuentran con un perro sabio y parlante llamado Hokuto que es un viejo amigo de Gingka. Hokuto les dice que Gingka está en la montaña para encontrar un pergamino que está escondido dentro de un santuario que se encuentra en el pico más alto. Gingka está decidido a encontrar el pergamino que podría ser la respuesta a más poder para Pegasus.

programme.title: El hadas verdes
programme.desc: Recién salido de su experiencia rejuvenecedora en la montaña, Gingka se reúne con la pandilla en Koma Village. Él y Hyoma muestran a sus amigos todos los lugares geniales de beyblading con los que solían luchar cuando eran niños. Finalmente, llegan a Green Hades, donde Gingka nunca pudo derrotar a Hyoma. Hyoma desafía a Gingka nuevamente y, por primera vez, Gingka gana gracias a su movimiento especial Pegasus Starblast Attack.

programme.title: ¡A la conquista del combate por parejas!
programme.desc: Cuando Madoka realiza el mantenimiento de los beys, intercambia las partes en Sagittario y Bull, lo que le da una fuerza sorprendente a sus actuaciones. Benkei y Kenta deciden aprovechar sus nuevas

programme.title: ¡Que comience el combate de supervivencia!
programme.desc: Doji lleva a Ryuga a un terreno remoto donde se encuentra con un niño misterioso que es un formidable oponente de Beyblade. Mientras tanto, Gingka y sus amigos participan en la competencia Survival Battle en Beyblade Island, cuyo ganador recibe un deseo. Todos están compitiendo, incluido Tetsuya, quien atrapa a Benkei y a algunos bladers injustamente hasta que cambian la situación.

programme.title: Renacimiento del juramento
programme.desc: En lugar de viajar al 7 de julio, Rintaro despierta en el año 2036 en el que el mundo ha sido devastado por la Tercera Guerra Mundial y sus amigos forman Valquiria, un grupo de resistencia que trata de construir una máquina del tiempo.

programme.title: Renacimiento de la formación de imágenes
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de Kurisu Amadeus, Rintaro viaja desde 2036 hasta 2011 cargando con las esperanzas de todos. Después de 3000 saltos y a pesar del desgaste mental, llega al 7 de julio de 2011 como el científico loco que una vez fue.

programme.title: La espada del aislamiento
programme.desc: Hypnos convoca a sus hijos, los dioses menores Iquelo, Oneiros, Fantaso y Morfeo, para que den muerte a un mortal que ha tenido la osadía de introducirse en el reino de los sueños. Se trata ni más ni menos que de El Cid, Caballero de Oro de Capricornio, que ha sido enviado tras Manigoldo con la misión de rescatar el alma de Sísifo, Caballero de Oro de Sagitario.

programme.title: Cárcel de sueños
programme.desc: Decidido a rescatar el alma de Sísifo, El Cid se enfrenta en solitario a los cuatro dioses del sueño. Mientras tanto, Tenma, camino del Castillo de Hades, se encuentra de repente en su pueblo. Allí se reúne con Sasha, que le asegura que todo lo sucedido hasta ahora no ha sido más que un sueño. Pero Tenma no puede evitar pensar que hay algo terriblemente equivocado en todo esto…

programme.title: Más allá de los sueños
programme.desc: Iquelo supera una y otra vez a El Cid en combate, pero el Caballero de Oro decide emplear su propia sangre derramada para derrotar a su enemigo. Al mismo tiempo, Tenma consigue escapar de la cárcel de sueños y se enfrenta abiertamente a Morfeo, quien se aprovecha de sus sentimientos para someterle. Pero justo entonces la Armadura de Pegaso parece cambiar…

programme.title: El camino de la rectitud
programme.desc: Tenma y El Cid se encuentran acorralados contra el poder combinado de Oneiros y sus compañeros Fantaso, Iquelo y Morfeo. Pero justo entonces Atenea llega al Mundo de los Sueños para despertar a Sísifo permitiendo a Tenma y El Cid reanudar la lucha con la intención de expulsar a Oneiros del Mundo de los Sueños y llevar el enfrentamiento al mundo real.

programme.title: El maestro de los monstruos
programme.desc: Integra se apuñala a sí misma para evitar convertirse en vampiro. Tras una operación de rescate, recuerda cómo conoció a Alucard y lo que pasó entre ellos dos antes de asumir el mando de la Organización Hellsing.

programme.title: Espinas que matan
programme.desc: Shiori, la que antaño fuera mejor amiga de Juri, se reincorpora a la academia Ohtori, pero Juri la trata con frialdad. La sociedad de la rosa negra le revela a Shiori los verdaderos sentimientos de Juri, aquellos que nunca ha confesado a nadie más.

programme.title: Mitsuru se impacienta
programme.desc: Mitsuru Tsuwabuki se molesta porque Nanami, su ídolo, sigue tratándolo como a un crío. A pesar de que prueba diversos métodos para parecer más mayor, más “adulto”, alguien a quien Nanami pueda ver como a un igual, sus intentos no parecen cuajar…

programme.title: La melodía de un reino caído
programme.desc: Tatsuya Kazami, a quien Wakaba admiraba y apodaba “el príncipe cebolla” cuando iban juntos a clase en la escuela primaria, reaparece ante ella. Para mayor sorpresa, en lugar de declararse a su antigua amiga, le pide una cita a Utena.

programme.title: Misión imposible
programme.desc: Después de escapar del ataque del departamento de ejecuciones, los Akudama llegan por fin a la guarida del Gato Negro, donde repasan los detalles del plan de ataque al Shinkansen. Para ello tendrán que superar la vigilancia extrema de la estación de Kansai y cumplir el objetivo antes de que se termine el tiempo del que disponen.

programme.title: Speed
programme.desc: El Shinkansen sale de la estación de Kansai y, a pesar del poco tiempo que les queda, si consiguen entregarle la caja fuerte al Gato Negro, la misión será un éxito. Sin embargo, tan solo disponen de 10 minutos más. Si superan ese tiempo, entrarán en la devastada zona de aislamiento total, donde lo único que reina es la muerte... y para terminar de complicar la situación, el dúo de ejecutores viaja en el mismo convoy.

programme.title: El dragón de ojos vendados
programme.desc: El grupo de Yona llega hasta una aldea escondida en las montañas, donde todos aseguran que no existe el Dragón Azul. A Yona y a sus amigos les resulta sospechoso y deciden quedarse para buscar en secreto al Dragón Azul.

programme.title: Terror reverberante
programme.desc: Haciendo oídos sordos a Hak, Yona se interna de nuevo en la cueva para pedirle al Dragón Azul que le preste el poder del dragón. Sin embargo, el Dragón Azul rechaza la petición de Yona y declara que el poder del dragón es una maldición. Haciendo oídos sordos a Hak, Yona se interna de nuevo en la cueva para pedirle al Dragón Azul que le preste el poder del dragón. Sin embargo, el Dragón Azul rechaza la petición de Yona y declara que el poder del dragón es una maldición. Haciendo oídos sordos a Hak, Yona se interna de nuevo en la cueva para pedirle al Dragón Azul que le preste el poder del dragón. Sin embargo, el Dragón Azul rechaza la petición de Yona y declara que el poder del dragón es una maldición.

programme.title: Fulgor / Face
programme.desc: El escuadrón Quinx trata de recomponerse tras el abandono de Haise, pero Mutsuki parte en su busca. Furuta asume el cargo del director de la CCG mientras un grupo de payasos asalta la ciudad y amenaza el cuartel general de la CCG.

programme.title: La mujer que siempre amó a Sesshomaru Parte 2
programme.desc: Sesshoumaru recuerda algo de su pasado. Inuyasha apenas se había apoderado de Tessaiga cuando él se encontraba débil y sin el brazo izquierdo. Fue entonces cuando empezó a eliminar a los soldados que pretendían aniquilar el castillo de Sara que no le permitían el paso. Por este motivo fue tomado como un héroe, pero temiendo que Sara se enamorara de él, su Padre decidió matar a Sesshoumaru, lo cual no ocurrió y desencadenó la locura del padre de Sara. Sara muestra su verdadera figura y Sesshoulmaru acaba con ella llevándola al otro mundo ya que fue poseída por demonios, pero no sin antes despedirse y de que Sara confiese sus sentimientos hacia él.

programme.title: El último banquete del maestro de Miroku
programme.desc: Están desapareciendo varios de los mejores y más famosos monjes de la región. Miroku se entera de que su maestro Moushin puede morir de alguna enfermedad así que va a visitarlo. Inuyasha, Sango, Kagome, Shippo y Miroku se encargan de cumplir por lo menos esta vez los últimos deseos de Moushin, pero descubren que el monje no estaba enfermo ni corría peligro.

programme.title: Un monstruo invisible, lo ves o no lo ves
programme.desc: Inuyasha y sus amigos se han quedado sin dinero, así que van a una de las aldeas cercanas a buscarse la vida. Sorprendentemente, se encuentran con la anciana que les ayudó contra la cabeza de ogro a la que se enfrentaron hace tiempo. La anciana les pide ayuda para exterminar a un bandido invisible. Shippo ejecuta una técnica que lo hace invisible temporalmente para descubrir al bandido, que resulta ser una persona que se desinfla y que se vuelve tan delgado que no se puede ver.

programme.title: El fin de Industria
programme.desc: Monsley y Lana se reencuentran con Luke en Industria. Conan, Jimsy y Dyce se infiltran en el Giganto y destruyen el motor principal, pero Lepka desprende las secciones dañadas de la nave. El grupo se separa y logra destruir los motores auxiliares, pero Jimsy y Dyce son expulsados ​​de la nave con destino desconocido. Lepka intenta escapar, pero su tripulación lo arrastra de regreso a la aeronave que cae mientras Conan escapa. Mientras tanto, el suelo bajo Industria comienza a ceder y sus habitantes se apresuran a evacuar. El Consejo decide quedarse atrás, despidiéndose del Profesor Lao y de los otros antes de que su poderosa ciudad se hunda.

programme.title: Final
programme.desc: El barco que zarpó de Industria recoge a Jimsy y Dyce, que quedaron varados en el mar después del accidente del Giganto. Lana se entera de que se separaron de Conan y Monsley advierte a Dyce que el estado del Profesor Lao está empeorando. El Profesor ayuda a Lana a usar sus poderes para localizar a Conan y el barco lo recoge. Pronto, el Profesor Lao sucumbe a sus heridas. La tripulación celebra una vigilia y se compromete a crear un mundo mejor. Algún tiempo después de que el barco atraque en High Harbor, la gente del pueblo se reúne para la botadura del Barracuda y el matrimonio de Dyce y Monsley. Conan, Lana, Jimsy, Tera y los recién casados zarpan hacia Isla Remanente con Luke y la gente de Industria. Cuando llegan, el grupo descubre que Isla Remanente se ha convertido en un continente, listo para un nuevo comienzo.

programme.title: La promesa del destino
programme.desc: Hitomi Kanzaki, estudiante de secundaria, forma parte del club de atletismo. Es una muchacha vital a la que le encanta tirar las cartas del tarot. Un día, durante un entrenamiento tiene una extraña visión: ve otro mundo en cuyo cielo aparece la Tierra y en donde las guerras las luchan robots gigantescos. Al día siguiente, el destino golpea. Hitomi descubre que Amano, un alumno más mayor que ella del que está secretamente enamorada se marcha a estudiar al extranjero. Basándose en las predicciones de las cartas del tarot, Hitomi decide declararle sus sentimientos. “¿Me darás mi primer beso si consigo bajar de la marca de los trece segundos?”. Esa misma tarde en la pista del instituto, Hitomi corre los 100 metros. Entonces aparecen Van Fanel, un joven armado con una espada, y un dragón enorme. Ambos libran un combate terrible. Son habitantes del otro mundo del que Hitomi tuvo la visión. Hitomi, Amano y Yukari, su mejor amiga, se refugian en una colina detrás de la escuela. Hitomi tiene una visión del dragón atravesando a Van con la cola. Advierte al muchacho, que evita el peligro y consigue la victoria. Pero sin apenas tiempo para respirar, se hace con el Drag Energist del dragón, que emite una luz antes de aspirar a Hitomi y a Van. Ambos son teletransportados al otro mundo, Gaia.

programme.title: La muchacha de la Luna de las Ilusiones
programme.desc: En el planeta Gaia, en el que la Tierra puede verse en el cielo, hay seres humanos, hombres lobo, hombres gato e incluso Dragones. Guiada por una tribu de hombres lobo, Hitomi descubre que Van es el heredero al trono de Fanelia, su destino. Encuentra a Merle, una joven chica gato que adora a Van tanto como detesta a Hitomi. Tras haber cumplido con éxito el ritual de la caza del dragón, Van es coronado y tienen lugar celebraciones en todo el reino. De repente, atacan enemigos invisibles. Estos destruyen la ciudad y aterrorizan a los habitantes, exactamente como Hitomi había predicho. Estos enemigos invisibles son los Alseides, armaduras mecánicas gigantescas del imperio Zaibacher. Los generales samuráis caen uno tras otro. Para proteger su patria, Van utiliza su Drag Energist para despertar al dios protector de Fanelia, el Guymelef Escaflowne. Hitomi ya había tenido una visión de esta batalla. Esta puede ver al enemigo invisible y ayuda a Van a contrarrestar el ataque de los Guymelefs. Pero Vargas, su guerrero más fiel, es abatido. Hitomi y Van son aspirados de nuevo por una columna de luz que les transporta a otro lugar junto al Escaflowne.

programme.title: Sumergido en el magma
programme.desc: El Octavo Ángel es descubierto en estado de crisálida en el cráter volcánico del Monte Asama. NERV lanza la Operación A-17 para capturar y recuperar vivo al Ángel. Asuka desciende al volcán a los mandos del EVA-02, el único de los tres EVA que está equipado con equipo especial para el combate en entornos extremos. Sin embargo, justo cuando creen que ha capturado al Ángel, este comienza a emerger. Asuka debe librar una batalla solitaria en el magma abrasador.

programme.title: Más allá de la oscuridad
programme.desc: Una mañana, Tokio-3 se ve afectada por un apagón inesperado y todas las funciones urbanas cesan por completo. Gendo y Fuyutsuki consideran que el apagón es un sabotaje por parte de un extraño y luchan por mantener MAGI y el Central Dogma. Entonces, el Noveno Ángel ataca. Shinji y los demás sienten el peligro inminente y se dirigen hacia el cuartel general de NERV. Allí se encuentran con los EVA que Gendo ha iniciado manualmente.

programme.title: El valor de un milagro
programme.desc: El Décimo Ángel intenta lanzar un ataque directo contra el cuartel general de NERV dejándose caer desde fuera de la atmósfera. Misato, que ha tomado el mando en el cuartel general, propone una estrategia que tiene solo un 0,00001% de posibilidades de éxito. Misato afirma que los milagros solo tienen valor cuando las personas hacen que ocurran, pero Ritsuko la acusa de actuar por su propio deseo de venganza personal ¿Se obrará el milagro que les salve de la caída del Ángel?

programme.title: La invasión del ángel
programme.desc: El Undécimo Ángel, el primero que consigue invadir NERV, es microscópico, del tamaño de una bacteria. Comienza a infectar las instalaciones de NERV a medida que evoluciona a un ritmo vertiginoso. Finalmente, el Ángel logra piratear el sistema MAGI y ordena al cuartel general de NERV que se autodestruya. Ritsuko propone hackear al Ángel enviándole un programa que hará que se destruya a sí mismo.

programme.title: El pez tuerto
programme.desc: Un pequeño capaz de percibir cosas que los demás no ven ni oyen... Una madre que trata ese don como una maldición... Una mujer con el pelo blanco y un único ojo, viviendo a orillas de un lago con peces que comparten con ella estos dos rasgos... Y una oscuridad que acecha desde el fondo del mismo... ¿Descubriremos algo acerca del origen de Ginko?

programme.title: Hiei va de combate en combate. ¡Dispara las Olas del Dragón Negro!
programme.desc: Tras derrotar a Makintaro en el primer combate de semifinales, el siguiente rival de Hiei es Kuro-Momotaro. Sin embargo, Hiei no es capaz de lanzar su ataque de las Olas del Dragón Negro debido a la dureza de los anteriores combates.

programme.title: La horrible metamorfosis de Kuro-Momotaro
programme.desc: Kuro-Momotaro se transforma una y otra vez incrementando su fuerza y obligando a Hiei a canalizar su poder a través de su espada para acabar con él. El siguiente combate de semifinales enfrenta a Kurama contra Uraurashima.

programme.title: La elegía del encierro Verso 1
programme.desc: El grupo conoce a Sara, una artista itinerante ciega que decide acompañarles en su viaje. Mugen queda prendado de su belleza y Fuu encuentra por fin una amiga, ¿pero cuál es el terrible secreto que se oculta tras ella?

programme.title: LEIRE MARTÍNEZ: Nuevo disco, un pasado en orquestas y La Oreja de Van Gogh | CARA C en LOS40 Podcast
programme.desc: Leire Martínez ha sido durante 17 años la vocalista de La oreja de Van Gogh. Pero esa etapa forma parte del pasado. Ahora emprende una nueva era en solitario con la ilusión de la que sabe que ha encontrado su camino, el que le hace feliz. Historias de aquella niña es el resultado de este nuevo camino que ha tomado. Del disco, de su grupo, de la maternidad, la conciliación familiar o, incluso, de Saiko y la forma en la que las nuevas generaciones entienden el amor ha hablado con ella Cris Regatero en Cara C. Sin dejar de lado su adolescencia, su paso por distintos talentos como Operación Triunfo o su experiencia como actriz. Una mujer camaleónica con mucha verdad en su discurso y dispuesta a hablar de todo.

programme.title: ¿Y tú qué miras?' Con María León: "No me gusta cuando nos hacemos grandes por la debilidad de otros"

programme.title: Ni tan bien 3x02 | Javier Coronas, la política del odio y la caída de los influencers
programme.desc: Segunda semana de septiembre y seguimos vivas. Yo lo veo un éxito. Aunque para éxito, el de nuestro invitado de esta semana (¿Habéis visto que forma de hilar? Ni las Moiras oye). En este programa nos acompaña el mitiquísimo presentador y humorista Javier Coronas. Con él hablamos del estreno de la VIGÉSIMA temporada de “Ilustres ignorantes”. Vigésima son veinte, que lo hemos tenido que buscar. 20 temporadas ya. Tiene más años el programa que las novias de Leonardo DiCaprio. Con Coronas hablamos precisamente de cuál es el secreto para tener un programa de televisión durante tantos años cuando todo cambia tan rápido. Y precisamente esa es la clave: Que ellos no cambian. Como la web de Renfe.
